axes: As York, Goodwood and Epsom: origin = winning post on the inside rail; y up. On the home straight the horses run towards -x; z is the horses' left. LEFT-handed: the inside rail (z = 0) on the horses' left, the track to z = -trackWidth on their right.

routesNote: Each route is its inside rail sampled every 'spacing' metres, from d0 (metres to go, negative = the run-out past the post) back to its far end; 'bends' for the race engine as [metres to go at the start, at the end, degrees turned (positive = towards the inside rail)]; 'heights' the ground along it. straight: 5f to 1m, the straight mile. mile: 1m from the chute off the far bend. round: 1m2f60y to 1m6f132y, round the home bend, along the far side, round the far bend into the straight. loop: 2m110y and 2m2f, from the home straight, past the post, once round.
